<CardGroup cols={2}>
  <Card title="Overview" icon="file-lines" href="/docs/build/apps/wallet/overview">

    In this guide we will use the Wallet SDK to integrate with the Stellar blockchain and connect to anchors.

  </Card>
  <Card title="Getting Started" icon="file-lines" href="/docs/build/apps/wallet/intro">

    Learn how to build a wallet application on the Stellar network with the Wallet SDK. Explore key features, setup steps, Stellar fundamentals, and anchor basics.

  </Card>
  <Card title="Stellar Network" icon="file-lines" href="/docs/build/apps/wallet/stellar">

    In the previous section we learned how to create a wallet and a Stellar object that provides a connection to Horizon.

  </Card>
  <Card title="Stellar Authentication" icon="file-lines" href="/docs/build/apps/wallet/sep10">

    Wallets connect to anchors using a standard way of authentication via the Stellar network defined by the SEP-10 standard.

  </Card>
  <Card title="Hosted Deposit and Withdrawal" icon="file-lines" href="/docs/build/apps/wallet/sep24">

    The SEP-24 standard defines the standard way for anchors and wallets to interact on behalf of users.

  </Card>
  <Card title="Recovery" icon="file-lines" href="/docs/build/apps/wallet/sep30">

    The Sep-30 standard defines the standard way for an individual (e.g., a user or wallet) to regain access to their Stellar account after losing its private...

  </Card>
  <Card title="Programmatic Deposit and Withdrawal" icon="file-lines" href="/docs/build/apps/wallet/sep6">

    The SEP-6 standard defines a way for anchors and wallets to interact on behalf of users.

  </Card>
  <Card title="Quote" icon="file-lines" href="/docs/build/apps/wallet/sep38">

    The SEP-38 standard defines a way for anchors to provide quotes for the exchange of an off-chain asset and a different on-chain asset, and vice versa.

  </Card>
  <Card title="URI Scheme to facilitate delegated signing" icon="file-lines" href="/docs/build/apps/wallet/sep7">

    The Sep-7 standard defines a way for a non-wallet application to construct a URI scheme that represents a specific transaction for an account to sign.

  </Card>
